supported_facts: MR6D includes16 objects and explicitly a Euro pallet.
Object selection favors standardized globally available objects unsuitable for ordinary two-finger/suction gripping.

confirmed_local_intake.selection_rule: ALL released frames in the five obj1-positive val scenes with at least one GTobj1; order scene numeric then original numeric JSON frame key. All obj1GT-list indices retained. No model outcomes/source visibility/error-based subset selection.
confirmed_local_intake.query_selection: Original R0 first-argmax proposal, native8 q/L/validities and all raw9 candidates; no GT-center query, nearest-permutation/candidate reselection or q correction.

authority_assessment.nominal_target_type: Euro pallet documented in official paper; local intake calls its selected obj1 source Euro wood.
uncertainties: Read documentation does not explicitly establish the numeric obj1↔Euro-pallet mapping as an official crosswalk; local intake is consistent but not independent proof of that mapping.
Class-positive scene/frame inclusion and retention of all obj1 GT list entries do not identify one intended physical instance for a particular R0 proposal.
A q8/context box is only the frozen initializer proposal; where visual selected-instance identity is ambiguous, future weak observations must remainUNKNOWN.
Nominal model/product semantics do not certify physical native-point identity, exact raster ownership, coordinate correctness or3px gold.
This is not evidence that the dataset or existing labels are wrong.
